pages.title: Infected Gauntlet
pages.text: A gauntlet overgrown by the crystals of The Abyss. It can wear up to five of your rings at once. Lay it into the middle of a Gauntlet Station and set your rings onto its five fingers around it.

pages.title: Infected Gauntlet
notes: Shape it in the Arcane Workbench.

pages.title: Gauntlet Station
pages.text: Your gauntlet in the middle, your five rings around it. Rings are only put on and taken off here.

pages.title: The Spell Wheel
pages.text: Hold R while the gauntlet is in your hand and a wheel of your rings appears. Point at a ring and let go of R to choose it. Right click casts the chosen ring, the middle mouse button its second magic if it has one. Both keys can be changed in the controls of The Abyss.
